classification.difficultyReason: Identify an unlabelled shared side as an intermediate target, choose ratios in two adjoining or overlapping right triangles, and carry the length into a second equation; another part requires subtracting a given segment from the total.

content.prompt: Find $x$ in each of the following figures. Give your answers to two decimal places.

spec.description: Two right triangles share a diagonal. The lower base is 2; the angles at the common left vertex are 39 degrees and 37 degrees. The upper triangle's hypotenuse is x. Decorative source fills are omitted.
spec.mathematics: The shared diagonal has length 2/cos(39 degrees); x is that length divided by cos(37 degrees). Coordinates are derived from these relationships.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible.

answer.short:
$x\approx3.22$.

Find the shared diagonal using $\cos39^\circ$, then use $\cos37^\circ$.

spec.description: An outer right triangle has hypotenuse 10 and top angle 36 degrees. The inner hypotenuse x makes 30 degrees with the shared base. Decorative blue fills are omitted.
spec.mathematics: The shared base is 10 sin(36 degrees). The inner hypotenuse is this base divided by cos(30 degrees).
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible.

answer.short:
$x\approx6.79$.

Find the shared base using $\sin36^\circ$, then use $\cos30^\circ$.

spec.description: A right triangle has base 4 and top angle 35 degrees. Its left side is divided into lower length 2 and upper length x; the dividing segment joins the base's right endpoint. Decorative fills are omitted.
spec.mathematics: The full vertical height is x+2, so tan(35 degrees)=4/(x+2).
spec.answerVisibility: The upper segment alone is labelled x; no total height or answer is supplied.

answer.short:
$x\approx3.71$.

Find the total height using $\tan35^\circ$, then subtract $2$.

spec.description: Two right triangles share a horizontal base. Vertical sides are x on the left and 8 on the right. Crossing diagonals connect opposite endpoints. The angles with the left and right vertical sides are respectively 50 degrees and 40 degrees. Decorative blue fills are omitted.
spec.mathematics: The common base is 8 tan(40 degrees) and is also x tan(50 degrees).
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x are visible.

answer.short:
$x\approx5.63$.

Find the shared base using $\tan40^\circ$, then use $\tan50^\circ$.
